mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 2100 units signals increased consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between HOUST and consumer confidence indices
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 2100, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 3.5% signals accommodative monetary policy, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns when FEDFUNDS < 3.5% are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A drop in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.5% signals a tightening labor market, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to expected wage growth and increased consumer spending.
evidence_refs: fact:historical relationship between UNRATE and wage growth
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances when UNRATE < 4.5, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The joint behavior of increasing RSAFS (above $350k) and decreasing UNRATE (below 5%) signals robust consumer demand and a strong labor market, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.04 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns when both conditions are met are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
